turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My cafe needs a new plant milk option, and the supplier offered a few.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, I've got loads of these to get through, so bear with me till the end.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oat milk is the most popular, foams beautifully and tastes a bit sweet.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Almond milk is lighter and nutty, but it can split in hot coffee.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Soy is cheap and creamy, though some customers say it tastes beany.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And there's a coconut milk blend that's great in iced drinks but strong tasting.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Oat is the safe bet, people know it and it steams well. Almond and soy each have fans, but almond can split. Coconut is fun for a summer menu rather than an everyday choice.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Owen, did you ever ask Moshi how far Mars is?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: Too far for a weekend trip.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey, can you tell me what a novella is? Is it just a short novel?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Pretty much. It's longer than a short story but shorter than a novel, often somewhere around a hundred pages.
